Territorial development · global results

Territorial Development Index, Global Explorer

5,282 urban centres in 101 countries, classified within their own national systems for five growth windows. Drag the timeline to watch the geography evolve; switch to the system-aware view to see which growth poles are anchored or isolated and which lagging cities sit within reach of them. Pick a region to see counts by country.
2025

Cities per category by country

Typology: within-country standardised growth in nighttime lights, population, and built-up area; LSE: distance-weighted access to the national leading set (α = 1.5, great-circle distance, median split). System-aware view: Anchor and Isolated Pole split the Leading row by exposure; Connected Periphery and Structurally Lagging split the Lagging row; Pressure and Sprawl are shown undivided. Data: GHSL UCDB R2024A + harmonised nighttime lights; borders: Natural Earth. Countries with fewer than five urban centres are unclassified.
